Blu001f.wav.speaker: BlueSpy
Blu001f.wav.en: Don't shoot me! I'll give you information!

Blu002e.wav.speaker: BlueSpy
Blu002e.wav.en: Your president is at a secret diplomatic meeting at a mountain retreat. The Tan are already moving to capture him.
Blu002e.wav.zh: 你们总统正在山间别墅开一场秘密外交会议。棕军已经出动去抓他了。

Cap002b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap002b.wav.en: HQ, I have one of Sarge's men on board.
Cap002b.wav.zh: 总部，我机上有一位中士的部下。

Cap003b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap003b.wav.en: Good to see you, Sarge. Where's the rest of your squad?
Cap003b.wav.zh: 很高兴见到你，中士。你其余的人呢？

Cap004c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap004c.wav.en: My radar is going crazy, Sarge. This place is crawling with Tan!
Cap004c.wav.zh: 中士，我的雷达快疯了。这地方到处都是棕军！

Cap005b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap005b.wav.en: Come in, HQ. I've got Sarge and his boys on board.
Cap005b.wav.zh: 总部请回答。中士和他的弟兄们都在我机上。

Cap006a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap006a.wav.en: Found some ammo for that side-mounted gun, Sarge. Care to do the honors?
Cap006a.wav.zh: 中士，我给侧装机炮找到些弹药。想不想来试试？

Cap007c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap007c.wav.en: Dang...! I'll take a serious beating flying over that bunker on the toilet.
Cap007c.wav.zh: 见鬼……！飞过马桶上那座碉堡，我非得挨一顿狠揍不可。

Cap008c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap008c.wav.en: Hold on to your dogtags, big guy.

Cap009c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap009c.wav.en: Okay, boys, looks like the LZ is clear.
Cap009c.wav.zh: 好了弟兄们，着陆区看来是清干净了。

Cap010c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap010c.wav.en: Whoa - that spray can's gonna blow!

Cap011a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap011a.wav.en: HQ, there's too many of them to take head on.
Cap011a.wav.zh: 总部，他们人太多了，正面硬拼不行。

Cap012c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap012c.wav.en: Don't move! You're coming with me.

Cap013c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap013c.wav.en: HQ, we have a situation. Tan guerillas are on the move to capture the president.
Cap013c.wav.zh: 总部，出状况了。棕军游击队正在行动，要抓总统。

Cap014a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap014a.wav.en: HQ, I've just spotted several Green POWs.
Cap014a.wav.zh: 总部，我刚发现几名绿军战俘。

Cap015c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap015c.wav.en: Oh no! The Tan have those boys covered with explosives! They're gonna use our own guys to blow the bridge!
Cap015c.wav.zh: 不好！棕军在那帮弟兄身上绑了炸药！他们要用我们自己人炸桥！

Cap017a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap017a.wav.en: That won't work... or will it?

Cap018b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap018b.wav.en: A couple more like that should do the trick.
Cap018b.wav.zh: 再来这么两下就差不多了。

Cap019f.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap019f.wav.en: Call me Blade... the Bridge Builder!
Cap019f.wav.zh: 叫我布莱德……桥梁建筑师！

Cap020c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap020c.wav.en: Okay men, break out that cargo. Let's have a look at my new ride.
Cap020c.wav.zh: 好了弟兄们，把那批货卸出来。看看我的新座驾。

Cap021a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap021a.wav.en: You can count on me, sir.

Cap023a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap023a.wav.en: HQ, the strike team is going in. Stand by.
Cap023a.wav.zh: 总部，突击队开始行动了。待命。

Cap025c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap025c.wav.en: Mornin', Mr. President. Buckle up; we're not out of the woods yet.
Cap025c.wav.zh: 早啊，总统先生。系好安全带，我们还没脱离险境。

Cap028b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap028b.wav.en: Looks like I've found a secret Tan R & R facility.
Cap028b.wav.zh: 看来我找到了棕军一处秘密休整基地。

Cap029b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap029b.wav.en: Ahhh, like Tan fish in a barrel.
Cap029b.wav.zh: 啊哈，棕军跟桶里的鱼一样好打。

Cap030a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap030a.wav.zh: 他们到底从哪儿冒出来的？

Cap032b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap032b.wav.en: No sweat - the cavalry is here.

Cap034c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap034c.wav.en: This is no good. I'll need a more powerful weapon.
Cap034c.wav.zh: 这样不行。我需要更强的武器。

Cap035c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap035c.wav.en: Ah, this should do the trick.

Cap038e.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap038e.wav.en: Outstanding. What do you think of that, Sarge?
Cap038e.wav.zh: 干得漂亮。中士，你觉得怎么样？

Cap039b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap039b.wav.en: Oh... so the Tan fly boy thinks he can play.
Cap039b.wav.zh: 哦……看来棕军那飞行员以为自己也行。

Cap043b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap043b.wav.zh: 算了，今天打不成冰球了。

Cap044b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap044b.wav.en: I'll play a game of hockey with this Tan rookie.
Cap044b.wav.zh: 我就陪这个棕军新兵打一场冰球。

Cap046i.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap046i.wav.en: Hmm -- he just shot a stone onto the board.
Cap046i.wav.zh: 嗯——他刚把一颗石子射到棋盘上。

Cap049c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap049c.wav.en: Damn! I've got to move faster.

Cap050a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap050a.wav.en: HQ, come in... do you have a location on that portal?
Cap050a.wav.zh: 总部请回答……那道传送门的位置有吗？

Cap052d.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap052d.wav.en: Looks like they've got quite a bug export operation here.
Cap052d.wav.zh: 看来他们这儿有个不小的虫子出口生意。

Cap053c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap053c.wav.en: Almost done, Colonel. Hang in there.

Cap057c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap057c.wav.en: Whoa! This area makes my spine tingle.
Cap057c.wav.zh: 哇！这地方让我脊背发凉。

Cap059a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap059a.wav.en: I don't like the looks of this!

Cap060a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap060a.wav.en: I've got a bad feeling about this.

Cap064b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap064b.wav.en: Why do they insist on getting killed?

Cap070c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap070c.wav.en: I'll be there when I get a chance.

Cap080a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap080a.wav.en: This will put a shine on the old bird.
Cap080a.wav.zh: 这能给老伙计添点光彩。

Cap084c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap084c.wav.en: This'll add some punch to my main gun.

Cap085b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap085b.wav.en: Hey, ammo for my side gun!

Cap086c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap086c.wav.en: This should slow the tan flyers down a bit.
Cap086c.wav.zh: 这能让那些棕军飞行员慢下来一点。

Cap087e.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap087e.wav.en: Countermeasures! This will stop incoming missiles!
Cap087e.wav.zh: 对抗措施！这能拦下来袭导弹！

Cap088c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap088c.wav.en: Heh heh, this green paint should confuse the tan.
Cap088c.wav.zh: 嘿嘿，这身绿漆该把棕军搞糊涂了。

Cap089a.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap089a.wav.en: Guided missiles. Can't wait to put these to use.
Cap089a.wav.zh: 制导导弹。等不及要用上了。

Cap091c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap091c.wav.en: Aha! This will make things hotter for anybody who gets too close.
Cap091c.wav.zh: 啊哈！谁靠太近，就得尝尝烫的滋味。

Cap096b.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap096b.wav.en: Can't wait to drop these on those pesky undersea vessels.
Cap096b.wav.zh: 等不及要往那些讨厌的水下舰艇上扔了。

Cap097c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap097c.wav.en: This should help me spot those underwater craft.
Cap097c.wav.zh: 这能帮我看清那些水下的家伙。

Cap098c.wav.speaker: Captain
Cap098c.wav.zh: 普拉斯特，你迟早有得受。

Col001b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col001b.wav.en: Captain, Grimm here. Good work so far, but now you're really gonna earn your wings. The president is heavily guarded. Take the strike team to recover him and hold the LZ until they bring him out. Then fly the president back to safety. Good luck.
Col001b.wav.zh: 上尉，我是格里姆。目前干得不错，但接下来才真要考验你的翅膀。总统身边守卫森严。带突击队去把他救出来，守住着陆区直到他们把人带出来。然后把总统安全运回。祝你好运。

Col002a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col002a.wav.en: Blade, bad news. Abort your mission.
Col002a.wav.zh: 布莱德，坏消息。中止任务。

Col004c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col004c.wav.en: Glad to have you back, Mr. President. Unfortunately, there's no time for celebration. We have to retake this village.
Col004c.wav.zh: 很高兴你回来了，总统先生。可惜没时间庆祝。我们得把这个村子夺回来。

Col005a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col005a.wav.en: Our reinforcements have arrived, Captain. It's time to restore peace to this village... let no Tan survive!
Col005a.wav.zh: 上尉，我们的援军到了。是时候让这个村子重归安宁了……别让一个棕军活下来！

Col006c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col006c.wav.en: Excellent work, everyone. We were able to run off the Tan without any serious...
Col006c.wav.zh: 各位干得漂亮。我们没费什么大劲就把棕军赶跑了……

Col008a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col008a.wav.en: Okay, Captain. We will come up with a plan to locate and attack Plastro's headquarters. You need to get back to that house and give Sarge a hand. On the double, men!
Col008a.wav.zh: 好了，上尉。我们要制定一个计划，找到并攻打普拉斯特的总部。你得回到那栋房子里帮中士一把。动作快点，弟兄们！

Col009a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col009a.wav.en: And Captain, give the Tan some hell!
Col009a.wav.zh: 还有上尉，让棕军吃点苦头！

Col010d.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col010d.wav.en: Careful with those weapons, Captain! Green citizens call this little village home, you know!
Col010d.wav.zh: 用那些武器小心点，上尉！绿军百姓把这小村子当家的！

Col011d.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col011d.wav.en: Blade! I want to restore peace to the village, not leave the village in pieces! Get it?!
Col011d.wav.zh: 布莱德！我是要让村子重归安宁，不是把村子打成碎片！明白吗？！

Col012b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col012b.wav.en: You have caused too much damage to the civilian homes, Captain. You're grounded.
Col012b.wav.zh: 上尉，你把平民的房屋破坏得太严重了。你被停飞了。

Col013a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col013a.wav.en: Captain! Thank goodness you made it. We really need your help.
Col013a.wav.zh: 上尉！谢天谢地你赶到了。我们真的很需要你帮忙。

Col014b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col014b.wav.en: The Gray Navy has developed some kind of sub-surface vessel. We are putting the finishing touches on a sonar detection system right now, but our destroyers are taking a serious pounding in the meantime.
Col014b.wav.zh: 灰军海军搞出了某种水下舰艇。我们正在给声呐探测系统做最后的调试，可这期间我们的驱逐舰正挨着狠揍。

Col015c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col015c.wav.en: We still have enough firepower to attack the real Tan headquarters, but first we have to locate that island.
Col015c.wav.zh: 我们的火力还够攻打真正的棕军总部，但首先得找到那座岛。

Col016b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col016b.wav.en: We have a couple of destroyers heading in to pick us up.
Col016b.wav.zh: 我们有两艘驱逐舰正开过来接我们。

Col017d.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col017d.wav.en: If you don't clear these waters of gray sub-surface ships in time, our destroyers will be shredded.
Col017d.wav.zh: 要是你不能及时把这片水域的灰军水下舰艇清干净，我们的驱逐舰就要被撕碎了。

Col018d.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col018d.wav.en: Come in, Blade. Listen. Those boats are going to be here any minute! Take out those Grey subs, fast!
Col018d.wav.zh: 布莱德请回答。听着，那些船随时都会到！快把那些灰军潜艇干掉！

Col019a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col019a.wav.en: Nice work, Blade. Now we need to find the Tan base so we can put Plastro's diabolical bug factory out of commission.
Col019a.wav.zh: 干得好，布莱德。现在我们得找到棕军基地，把普拉斯特那个邪恶的虫子工厂给废了。

Col020c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col020c.wav.en: And remember... conserve your missiles out there. You're not going to have many chances to rearm.
Col020c.wav.zh: 还有记住……在外头省着点用导弹。你能补弹的机会不多。

Col021a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col021a.wav.en: Those Grey ships must be coming from somewhere! Use sonar buoys to track them down.
Col021a.wav.zh: 那些灰军舰艇一定有个来处！用声呐浮标把它们找出来。

Col022a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col022a.wav.en: Radio signal from HQ is down, Captain. Something is strange about this area of the ocean.
Col022a.wav.zh: 上尉，总部的无线电信号断了。这片海域有点不对劲。

Col023a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col023a.wav.en: You are going to have to find that portal!

Col024a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col024a.wav.en: Step it up, Blade! A Tan chopper just spotted our ships. We're sitting ducks out here if they start firing torpedoes!
Col024a.wav.zh: 快点，布莱德！一架棕军直升机刚发现了我们的船。他们要是开始放鱼雷，我们在这儿就是活靶子！

Col025c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col025c.wav.en: Their submersibles are moving in, Captain... it's now or never!
Col025c.wav.zh: 上尉，他们的潜航器正在逼近……就是现在，不然就完了！

Col026b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col026b.wav.en: We've taken a direct hit, Captain! We're going down! It's all over!
Col026b.wav.zh: 上尉，我们被直接命中了！我们在下沉！全完了！

Col027f.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col027f.wav.en: Excellent, Blade! You've discovered Plastro's volcano fortress. Clear the small island, but don't blast that bridge. With all their fortifications, it'll be impossible to establish a beachhead on the larger island.
Col027f.wav.zh: 太棒了，布莱德！你发现了普拉斯特的火山要塞。把小岛清干净，但别炸那座桥。他们有那么多工事，大岛上根本没法建立登陆场。

Col029b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col029b.wav.en: Those insects could really wreak havoc on our landing...!
Col029b.wav.zh: 那些虫子真能在我们登陆时闹翻天……！

Col030c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col030c.wav.en: Hurry it up, Captain! They're marshalling their forces!
Col030c.wav.zh: 快点，上尉！他们在集结兵力！

Col031a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col031a.wav.en: It's too late! We're finished, Captain.

Col032c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col032c.wav.en: The bridge is down! It's over!

Col033a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col033a.wav.en: Smartly done, Blade. We'll be there shortly.
Col033a.wav.zh: 干得漂亮，布莱德。我们马上到。

Col034c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col034c.wav.en: Stop those suicide troopers with the firecrackers strapped to them! They're trying to blow the bridge!
Col034c.wav.zh: 拦住那些身上绑着爆竹的自杀兵！他们想炸桥！

Col035c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col035c.wav.en: Watch out! More suicide soldiers at the bridge!
Col035c.wav.zh: 小心！桥边又来了一批自杀兵！

Col036c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col036c.wav.en: Alright, men, this is it. We need to cross to the other island and storm Plastro's fortress. Blade, we need you to cover us when we're on the bridge. When the battle gets chaotic, help direct our forces from the air.
Col036c.wav.zh: 好了弟兄们，就是这一仗。我们要渡过海峡，强攻普拉斯特的要塞。布莱德，我们上桥的时候需要你掩护。战况一乱，你就从空中帮我们指挥部队。

Col037c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col037c.wav.zh: 好！让这帮家伙尝尝厉害，弟兄们！

Col042a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col042a.wav.en: As I always say, the way to win the war is to never lose!
Col042a.wav.zh: 我常说，打赢战争的办法就是永远别输！

Col043a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col043a.wav.en: Don't give up man! You're never beaten until you admit it!
Col043a.wav.zh: 别放弃，弟兄！只要你不认输，就永远没被打败！

Col044a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col044a.wav.en: We've got to press them in the air and on the ground. It's time for each of us to look inside ourselves and see what kind of plastic we're made of.  Are we hollow men?  Or are we plastic soldiers?!
Col044a.wav.zh: 我们得在空中和地面上同时压住他们。现在是时候各自审视内心，看看我们是用什么塑料做的了。我们是空心人？还是塑料战士？！

Col045c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col045c.wav.en: Welcome to the Helicopter Flight and Combat Training Facility, Captain!
Col045c.wav.zh: 欢迎来到直升机飞行与作战训练场，上尉！

Col046c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col046c.wav.en: You will use this area to hone your flight combat skills. Train for as long as you need, but remember, there is a war raging out there!
Col046c.wav.zh: 你可以在这里磨练空战技巧。想练多久就练多久，但记住，外头还有一场战争在打！

Col047c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col047c.wav.en: I'll turn you over to our Radio Ops Specialist now. Good luck.
Col047c.wav.zh: 我现在把你交给我们的无线电作战专员。祝你好运。

Col048a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col048a.wav.en: Take care of your helicopter, Captain. Out in the field, you don't get second chances!
Col048a.wav.zh: 照顾好你的直升机，上尉。到了战场上，可没有第二次机会！

Col049c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col049c.wav.en: The president has been killed inside the house!

Col050b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col050b.wav.en: The strike team has been killed! The president is lost.
Col050b.wav.zh: 突击队阵亡了！总统也丢了。

Col051a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col051a.wav.en: The Gray Navy has developed some kind of sub-surface vessel. They're moving in to attack our destroyers. Use sonar buoys and depth charges to take those subs out!
Col051a.wav.zh: 灰军海军搞出了某种水下舰艇，正逼近攻击我们的驱逐舰。用声呐浮标和深水炸弹把那些潜艇干掉！

Col052b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col052b.wav.en: We still have enough firepower to attack the real Tan headquarters, but first we need to get off this island.
Col052b.wav.zh: 我们的火力还够攻打真正的棕军总部，但首先得离开这座岛。

Col053c.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col053c.wav.en: Okay Captain. You need to transport our men off the island. Get them to the destroyers... and keep those damn subs from sinking our boats, will ya!
Col053c.wav.zh: 好了上尉。你得把我们的人运出这座岛。把他们送到驱逐舰上……还有，别让那些该死的潜艇把我们的船弄沉了，行吗！

Col054b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col054b.wav.en: Don't forget about those submarines, Captain. Our destroyers are vulnerable to their torpedoes.
Col054b.wav.zh: 别忘了那些潜艇，上尉。我们的驱逐舰挡不住他们的鱼雷。

Col055b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col055b.wav.en: They're trying to take out our weapons, Captain!  If we lose all four guns on either boat, it's all over!
Col055b.wav.zh: 上尉，他们想打掉我们的武器！两艘船上任意一艘的四门炮全没了，就全完了！

Col056b.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col056b.wav.en: High numbers of Grey subs in this area lead us to believe they are using a secret under-water portal. Perhaps a well-placed depth charge could bring it to the surface. Find that portal and lead us through it.
Col056b.wav.zh: 这一带灰军潜艇数量这么多，说明他们用了某种秘密水下传送门。也许一颗投得准的深水炸弹能把它逼出水面。找到那道传送门，带我们穿过去。

Col057a.wav.speaker: Grimm
Col057a.wav.en: Excellent, Blade. You've discovered Blastro's secret volcano fortress. We need to land on the small southern island. Clear it of tan and mutant insects, but don't blow that bridge. We'll need to use it for our final sneak attack.

Pla008b.wav.zh: 这座岛是我的——全是我的！

Sam102e.wav.en: Captain, do you read me? Blade! Come in! Captain Blade!
Sam102e.wav.zh: 上尉，能听到吗？布莱德！请回答！布莱德上尉！

Sam103a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam103a.wav.en: Sir, is everything okay? We need you back in Polymer Village.
Sam103a.wav.zh: 长官，一切还好吗？我们得让你回聚合物村。

Sam104a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam104a.wav.en: You have to save our men, Captain Blade...!
Sam104a.wav.zh: 你必须救出我们的人，布莱德上尉……！

Sam105b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam105b.wav.en: Our casualty count is getting high, Captain.
Sam105b.wav.zh: 上尉，我们的伤亡数字越来越高了。

Sam106d.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam106d.wav.en: We can't win this if we keep losing troops.
Sam106d.wav.zh: 再这么损失部队，我们赢不了。

Sam107c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam107c.wav.en: We cannot lose more than one vehicle, Captain.
Sam107c.wav.zh: 上尉，我们最多只能损失一辆车。

Sam108a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam108a.wav.en: We just lost a vehicle! Any more and we can't pull this off!
Sam108a.wav.zh: 我们刚损失一辆车！再损失就没法打了！

Sam109b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam109b.wav.en: Do not allowed the village to be destroyed, Captain.

Sam110a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam110a.wav.en: You must save the village, Captain.

Sam111b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam111b.wav.en: Too many buildings have been damaged.

Sam112a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam112a.wav.en: Your mission objective has not changed. Return to the landing zone and use the beacon to load ground troops on to your 'copter.
Sam112a.wav.zh: 你的任务目标没变。回到着陆区，用信标把地面部队装上直升机。

Sam113b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam113b.wav.en: I'm sorry, sir, following my instructions is the only way to learn. Come back when you're ready to try again.
Sam113b.wav.zh: 抱歉长官，照我说的做是唯一的学法。等你准备好再来一次。

Sam114a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam114a.wav.en: Excellent. The buttons at the bottom left of your screen represent those men in your 'copter.
Sam114a.wav.zh: 很好。屏幕左下角的按钮代表你直升机上的士兵。

Sam115c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam115c.wav.en: Now that the men are on board, you have a new mission objective. Fly those troops to the LZ indicated on radar, and drop them off.
Sam115c.wav.zh: 人已上机，你有新的任务目标。把这些部队运到雷达标示的着陆区，然后把他们放下。

Sam116b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam116b.wav.en: To unload your troops, select the one you want by clicking on his button with your mouse cursor. Then click on the 'Eject Cargo' button located in the lower right corner of the on-screen display.
Sam116b.wav.zh: 要放下部队，先用鼠标点选你要放的那名士兵的按钮，然后点屏幕右下角的“抛出货物”按钮。

Sam117c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam117c.wav.en: Your next objective is target practice. To the west there are some Tan targets. Use your forward gun to destroy them.
Sam117c.wav.zh: 下一个目标是打靶。西边有一些棕军靶子。用前射机炮摧毁它们。

Sam118c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam118c.wav.en: To be most effective in combat, you will need to learn to collect and use power-ups.
Sam118c.wav.zh: 要在战斗中发挥最大威力，你得学会收集和使用强化道具。

Sam119b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam119b.wav.en: Once again, your radar will guide you to power-up locations. Return here when you have collected three new weapons.
Sam119b.wav.zh: 雷达会再次把你引到强化道具的位置。集齐三件新武器就回来。

Sam120a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam120a.wav.en: Excellent, Captain. The buttons at the bottom left of your screen represent those power-ups in your cargo bay. To select the one you want to use, click on the desired button with your mouse cursor.
Sam120a.wav.zh: 很好，上尉。屏幕左下角的按钮代表货舱里的强化道具。要选用哪个，就用鼠标点那个按钮。

Sam121a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam121a.wav.en: There are two power-up areas, Captain - one to the south of here and one to the east. Collect all three power-ups from each area.
Sam121a.wav.zh: 上尉，有两个强化道具区——一个在南边，一个在东边。每个区各把三件都收齐。

Sam122b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam122b.wav.en: Tan units vehicles are arriving, Captain, and this time they are going to shoot back!
Sam122b.wav.zh: 上尉，棕军车辆过来了，这回他们会还击！

Sam123c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam123c.wav.en: For a coordinated ground and air strike, use the beacon to summon ground troops to your location.
Sam123c.wav.zh: 要打地空协同，用信标把地面部队召到你所在的位置。

Sam124b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam124b.wav.en: Remember to pick up armor power-ups if you are damaged.
Sam124b.wav.zh: 受伤了记得捡装甲强化道具。

Sam125a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam125a.wav.en: Okay sir, you have all the skills you need to take on the Tan. Report for your first mission immediately.
Sam125a.wav.zh: 好了长官，对付棕军该会的你都会了。立刻去报到执行第一个任务。

Sam126b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam126b.wav.en: To drop items that you have picked up, Captain, click on the 'Lower Winch' button. If your HUD buttons are on, this button will appear in the lower right corner of the on-screen display.
Sam126b.wav.zh: 上尉，要放下你吊起的东西，点“下放绞盘”按钮。如果开了 HUD 按钮，这个按钮会出现在屏幕右下角。

Sam127a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam127a.wav.en: That's bad news. The President is carrying our secret helicopter plans! We cannot let Plastro get his hands on them! There is a portal in the bathtub that will bring you close to the President's mountain retreat. Get through it! Our strike team will meet you when you get there.
Sam127a.wav.zh: 这是坏消息。总统带着我们直升机的机密图纸！绝不能让普拉斯特拿到！浴缸里有一道传送门，能把你送到总统山间别墅附近。穿过去！到了之后突击队会跟你会合。

Sam128a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam128a.wav.en: Do you think that sprinkler under the window could be useful?
Sam128a.wav.zh: 你觉得窗户下面那个喷头会不会有用？

Sam129a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam129a.wav.en: Try turning on the water faucet. A jet of water from that sprinkler might be able to get you up to that window ledge.
Sam129a.wav.zh: 试着打开水龙头。那个喷头喷出的水柱也许能把你顶到窗台上。

Sam130a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam130a.wav.en: Rendezvous with the Recon team and secure the bridge.
Sam130a.wav.zh: 和侦察队会合，拿下那座桥。

Sam131e.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam131e.wav.en: It's an ambush! Fall back! Fall back!

Sam132b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam132b.wav.en: Those infantrymen are at your command, Captain. Drop them behind enemy lines for a tactical advantage.
Sam132b.wav.zh: 上尉，那些步兵听你调遣。把他们投到敌后，取得战术优势。

Sam133c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam133c.wav.en: The convoy has arrived. They are carrying equipment vital to rescuing the president, so keep them safe and lead them north to the village.
Sam133c.wav.zh: 车队到了。他们运的是营救总统急需的装备，保护好他们，带他们往北去村子。

Sam134a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam134a.wav.en: They took out one of our cargo trucks, Captain. If we lose the last one, the mission will be lost!
Sam134a.wav.zh: 上尉，他们打掉了我们一辆卡车。要是最后一辆也没了，任务就完了！

Sam135b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam135b.wav.en: Too much vital equipment was destroyed with our trucks, Captain. We've lost.
Sam135b.wav.zh: 上尉，太多关键装备随卡车一起毁了。我们输了。

Sam136d.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam136d.wav.en: The president at LZ, Captain. Where are you?
Sam136d.wav.zh: 上尉，总统已到着陆区。你在哪儿？

Sam137c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam137c.wav.en: That spy had vital information. Killing him was a bad idea.
Sam137c.wav.zh: 那名间谍有重要情报。杀了他是个坏主意。

Sam138a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam138a.wav.en: The Tan are building a chemical weapon on the desk. Get Sarge and his men up there so they can secure the area.
Sam138a.wav.zh: 棕军正在桌上造化学武器。把中士和他的部下送上去，让他们控制那片区域。

Sam139a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam139a.wav.en: Check your F1 map for more information.
Sam139a.wav.zh: 按 F1 看地图，了解详情。

Sam141a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam141a.wav.en: Get all three chemicals and drop them in the container on the desk. These chemicals should combine to make a potent volcano powder weapon that we can use in our attack on the Tan.
Sam141a.wav.zh: 把三份化学品都拿到，倒进桌上的容器里。这些化学品混起来应该能制成强力的火山粉武器，供我们攻打棕军时用。

Sam142a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam142a.wav.en: Drop that chemical into the container, Captain.
Sam142a.wav.zh: 上尉，把那份化学品倒进容器。

Sam143c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam143c.wav.en: Captain, drop off your men at the LZ on the desk right now!
Sam143c.wav.zh: 上尉，马上把你的人放到了桌上的着陆区！

Sam144b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam144b.wav.en: New orders! After you destroy those cargo trucks, you need to eliminate all of the mutant insects as well. Good luck!
Sam144b.wav.zh: 新命令！摧毁那些卡车之后，你还要把所有变异昆虫都清干净。祝你好运！

Sam145a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam145a.wav.en: YOU HAVEN'T DESTROYED ALL THE INSECTS!

Sam146c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam146c.wav.en: Welcome, Captain Blade. I'm going to run you, step by step, through all of the skills you will need in your upcoming missions. Please pay close attention.
Sam146c.wav.zh: 欢迎，布莱德上尉。我要一步步带你过一遍接下来任务里需要的所有技能。请仔细听。

Sam147b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam147b.wav.en: During these exercises, please make sure you have your HUD buttons on. When active, these buttons will appear in the lower corners of the on-screen display.
Sam147b.wav.zh: 做这些练习时，请确保 HUD 按钮是开着的。开启后这些按钮会出现在屏幕下方两角。

Sam148c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam148c.wav.en: Press your keyboard's F1 key at any time to see your current objectives and other vital data.
Sam148c.wav.zh: 随时按键盘上的 F1 键，可以查看当前目标和其他重要数据。

Sam149c.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam149c.wav.en: The instrument in the upper left corner of the on-screen display is your radar. It displays your mission objectives, landing zones, and the locations of troopers and vehicles.
Sam149c.wav.zh: 屏幕左上角的仪表是雷达。它显示你的任务目标、着陆区，以及士兵和车辆的位置。

Sam150a.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam150a.wav.en: Mission objectives on your radar will flash yellow. If your objective is outside the range of your radar, a directional indicator light, on the outer edge, will give you that objective's heading.
Sam150a.wav.zh: 雷达上的任务目标会闪黄光。如果目标超出雷达范围，外缘的方位指示灯会给出该目标的方位。

Sam151b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam151b.wav.en: If you have more than one mission objective, the directional indicator will point to the closest one.
Sam151b.wav.zh: 如果有多个任务目标，方位指示灯会对准最近的那个。

Sam152b.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam152b.wav.en: Click on the 'Drop Beacon' button, located in lower right corner of the on-screen display, to direct friendly ground troops to your location.
Sam152b.wav.zh: 点屏幕右下角的“投放信标”按钮，把友军地面部队调到你所在的位置。

Sam153d.wav.speaker: Sam
Sam153d.wav.en: Your objective is to load all of those nearby troops on to your 'copter. To do so, simply drop a beacon while you are landed.
Sam153d.wav.zh: 你的目标是把附近所有部队装上直升机。做法很简单：着陆时投一个信标。

Sar002c.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar002c.wav.en: I sent my men on recon, toward the house. Let's get this bird airborne.
Sar002c.wav.zh: 我派弟兄们去房子那边侦察了。咱们把这铁鸟升空吧。

Sar003a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar003a.wav.en: I need to stay on board, Blade.

Sar005a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar005a.wav.en: Okay Captain, my last man must be closer to the house. Let's head over there.
Sar005a.wav.zh: 好了上尉，我最后一个兵一定离房子更近。往那边飞。

Sar006b.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar006b.wav.en: Okay. Now, let's find that soldier!
Sar006b.wav.zh: 好，现在把那个兵找出来！

Sar008a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar008a.wav.en: I'm gonna need both of my guys in there, Cap'n.
Sar008a.wav.zh: 上尉，我那两个弟兄得一起进去。

Sar009b.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar009b.wav.en: Captain... this is Sarge... where the heck are ya? Over.
Sar009b.wav.zh: 上尉……我是中士……你到底在哪儿？完毕。

Sar010c.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar010c.wav.en: HQ, this is Sarge. We've discovered a huge Tan base inside that house.
Sar010c.wav.zh: 总部，我是中士。我们在那栋房子里发现了一处巨大的棕军基地。

Sar011a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar011a.wav.en: We've got orders to get inside that house. Think you could give us a lift?
Sar011a.wav.zh: 我们奉命要进那栋房子。能捎我们一程吗？

Sar013a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar013a.wav.en: No problem. Just get us up there fast - we'll take it out.
Sar013a.wav.zh: 没问题。快把我们送上去，我们把它端了。

Sar014a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar014a.wav.en: Blade, we need to get to that LZ.
Sar014a.wav.zh: 布莱德，我们得去那个着陆区。

Sar015d.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar015d.wav.en: Hurry it up, Captain! We've got to get to that landing zone.
Sar015d.wav.zh: 快点，上尉！我们得赶到那个着陆区。

Sar016d.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar016d.wav.en: If we don't get to that landing zone ASAP, it's all over.
Sar016d.wav.zh: 我们要是不能尽快赶到那个着陆区，就全完了。

Sar021c.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar021c.wav.en: Now get us to the landing zone on the floor; we have Tan to kill.
Sar021c.wav.zh: 现在把我们送到地面上的着陆区，还有棕军要收拾。

Sar022b.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar022b.wav.en: Blade, get us up to the coffee table.
Sar022b.wav.zh: 布莱德，把我们送到咖啡桌上。

Sar023h.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar023h.wav.en: Hold it, Captain! We need support, fast!
Sar023h.wav.zh: 撑住，上尉！我们急需支援！

Sar024c.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar024c.wav.en: Okay, Blade. HQ wants this area secured. We must find and destroy the source of those balloons, clear the sofa of artillery, and destroy all of Tan's armored vehicles. And intel reports the Blue spy is joyriding here somewhere. They want him pronto. Ready for some fun?
Sar024c.wav.zh: 好了布莱德。总部要我们把这一片控制住。我们得找到并摧毁那些气球的来源，把沙发上的炮兵清干净，再干掉棕军所有装甲车辆。还有情报说那个蓝军间谍就在这儿兜风，他们急着要人。准备好热闹一下了吗？

Sar025c.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar025c.wav.en: We are taking too many casualties! Fall back, fall back!

Sar026a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar026a.wav.en: They are all over us. Pull your weight, Captain, or we're done for!
Sar026a.wav.zh: 他们把我们团团围住了。上尉，出把力，不然我们都完了！

Sar027a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar027a.wav.en: We have them on the run. Track them down and take 'em out, Captain.
Sar027a.wav.zh: 他们跑了。上尉，追上去干掉他们。

Sar028b.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar028b.wav.en: OOOOHHRAAA! Flying like that deserves the Plastic Cross.
Sar028b.wav.zh: 好哇——！飞成这样，该给你发塑料十字勋章。

Sar029d.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar029d.wav.en: They've taken almost all the chemical drums.
Sar029d.wav.zh: 化学桶几乎全被他们抢走了。

Sar030b.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar030b.wav.en: Look who I found. Where are the chemicals, Grey?
Sar030b.wav.zh: 看我找到谁了。灰军，化学品在哪儿？

Sar032a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar032a.wav.en: The boys just spotted a tan convoy. Let's give them hell.
Sar032a.wav.zh: 弟兄们刚发现一支棕军车队。让他们尝尝厉害。

Sar034a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar034a.wav.en: Fellows, I've got an idea. Sorry, Grey; we're gonna need your clothes.
Sar034a.wav.zh: 弟兄们，我有个主意。抱歉了灰军，我们得借你的衣服用用。

Sar036e.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar036e.wav.en: Kill the troops near that shoe and get me to that landing zone behind it. I'll sneak in and eliminate the guards.
Sar036e.wav.zh: 把那只鞋附近的兵清掉，然后把我送到鞋后面那个着陆区。我偷偷摸进去把守卫解决掉。

Sar037a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar037a.wav.en: The guards are down! Cover me while I make a run for the landing zone!
Sar037a.wav.zh: 守卫都倒下了！我要冲去着陆区，掩护我！

Sar039c.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar039c.wav.en: Thanks, Ca-- What...?!? The boys just spotted a Tan convoy!
Sar039c.wav.zh: 谢了上—— 什么……？！弟兄们刚发现一支棕军车队！

Sar040a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar040a.wav.en: A bogus piece of intel brought us to this damn island, and now the Tan have us pinned down here.
Sar040a.wav.zh: 一份假情报把我们引到这座该死的岛上，现在棕军把我们钉在这儿了。

Sar041c.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar041c.wav.en: And my guys seem to be fighting a new breed of giant mutant creepy-crawly every day!
Sar041c.wav.zh: 我这帮弟兄好像每天都在跟新出现的巨型变异爬虫打。

Sar042d.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar042d.wav.en: My boys can't hold off these bugs much longer, Captain. We need to get to those boats!
Sar042d.wav.zh: 上尉，我的人顶不住这些虫子多久了。我们得赶到那些船上去！

Sar044c.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar044c.wav.en: We could use some air support back here at the citadel, Captain.
Sar044c.wav.zh: 上尉，我们在要塞这边需要点空中支援。

Sar045c.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar045c.wav.en: Captain, here's that Plastic Volcano Powder. We're still not sure exactly what it does, but I'm sure you'll know when it's time.
Sar045c.wav.zh: 上尉，这就是那批塑料火山粉。我们还不确定它到底有什么用，但到时候你肯定知道该怎么用。

Sar046b.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar046b.wav.en: The bridge is out! We'll just have to count on the guys who already made it over.
Sar046b.wav.zh: 桥断了！只能指望已经过河的那帮弟兄了。

Sar047f.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar047f.wav.en: Colonel Grimm is dead, Captain! It's a massacre! We're doomed!
Sar047f.wav.zh: 上尉，格里姆上校死了！这是一场屠杀！我们完了！

Sar054b.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar054b.wav.en: Ahhh, that takes the sting out of it.

Sar057a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar057a.wav.en: I'm ready to leave this sector.
Sar057a.wav.zh: 我准备撤离这片区域了。

Sar067f.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar067f.wav.zh: 布莱德，我们得马上撤离！

Sar068a.wav.speaker: Sarge
Sar068a.wav.en: I see my trooper down there, Captain. Use your beacon to direct him out and back to the LZ.
Sar068a.wav.zh: 上尉，我看见我的兵在下面。用你的信标把他引出来，带回着陆区。

Tro010f.wav.speaker: GreenTrooper
Tro010f.wav.en: There are too many of them!

Tro018c.wav.speaker: GreenTrooper
Tro018c.wav.en: Tell my wife I love her.

blu001c.wav.speaker: BlueSpy
blu001c.wav.en: Don't shoot me! I'll give you information!

blu002f.wav.speaker: BlueSpy
blu002f.wav.en: Your president is attending a secret diplomatic meeting at a mountain retreat. The TAN are already moving to capture him.
blu002f.wav.zh: 你们总统正在山间别墅参加一场秘密外交会议。棕军已经出动去抓他了。

capt108d.wav.speaker: Captain
capt108d.wav.en: Those men won't have given their lives for nothing! We are going to complete this mission and make the Tan pay! But first, I've got to find a way to rebuild that bridge.
capt108d.wav.zh: 那些弟兄不能白白牺牲！我们要完成这次任务，让棕军付出代价！但首先，我得想办法把桥重建起来。

gry001d.wav.speaker: GreySpy
gry001d.wav.en: (notused)The chemicals are on the floor. One is guarded by a combination device. The other is in a tent on the colored mat, but the red and yellow areas are tripwired. And the guards will blow it up if you try anything!
gry001d.wav.zh: 化学品就放在地上。一份有密码装置看守。另一份在彩色垫子上的帐篷里，但红色和黄色区域都布了绊线。你要敢乱动，守卫就会把它炸掉！

sam154dc.wav.speaker: Sam
sam154dc.wav.en: You've still got work to do...! Shoot into your bowl, Captain.
sam154dc.wav.zh: 你还有活儿没干完……！上尉，往自己的碗里射子。

sar069a.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar069a.wav.en: Come on, Captain. Those boys are waiting for us to pick them up!
sar069a.wav.zh: 来吧上尉，那帮弟兄正等着我们去接。

sar070a.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar070a.wav.en: Captain, before you drop us off, maybe you should let us take care of that bunker on top of the toilet for ya.
sar070a.wav.zh: 上尉，把我们放下之前，也许该让我们先帮你把马桶顶上那座碉堡解决掉。

sar071f.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar071f.wav.en: Holy...! Captain, we're gonna need support, fast!
sar071f.wav.zh: 我的天……！上尉，我们急需支援！

sar072c.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar072c.wav.en: Captain, we have to get up to that desk.
sar072c.wav.zh: 上尉，我们得上那张桌子。

sar074c.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar074c.wav.en: There has to be a way to get to that tent... we'll need to use stealth.
sar074c.wav.zh: 一定有办法到那个帐篷去……我们得用隐蔽手段。

sar075c.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar075c.wav.en: I'll send one squad at a time from the citadel to the LZ. You need to pick them up and drop them off on the destroyers.
sar075c.wav.zh: 我从要塞一批一批往着陆区送人。你得把他们接上，放到驱逐舰上。

sar076d.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar076d.wav.en: Those damn bugs will swarm as soon as we are exposed. Don't let my men become bug food, Captain!
sar076d.wav.zh: 我们一暴露，那些该死的虫子就会扑上来。上尉，别让我的人变成虫子的口粮！

sar077b.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar077b.wav.en: When everyone else is safe, I'll run to the LZ last.
sar077b.wav.zh: 等其他人都安全了，我最后一个跑去着陆区。

sar078a.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar078a.wav.en: There they go! Protect that squad and get them to the boats.
sar078a.wav.zh: 他们出发了！保护那个小队，把他们送到船上。

sar079a.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar079a.wav.zh: 上尉，又一支队伍出发了！

sar080c.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar080c.wav.en: Okay, Captain, I'm heading to the beach! Pick me up and let's get out of here!
sar080c.wav.zh: 好了上尉，我正往海滩去！把我接上，咱们撤！

sar081c.wav.speaker: Sarge
sar081c.wav.en: There has to be a way to get to that tent. We'll need to be smart about this.
sar081c.wav.zh: 一定有办法到那个帐篷去。这事我们得动点脑子。
